questions.question: The marked price of an item is 25% above its cost price. A shopkeeper sells it, allowing a discount of x% on the marked price. If he incurs a loss of 8%, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
Let CP of the article be Rs. 100

MP of the article = 100 × (125/100) = Rs. 125

SP of the article = 100 × (92/100) = Rs. 92

Discount = 125 – 92 = 33

Discount percentage = 33/125 × 100 = 26.4%

**Short Trick:**

-8 = 25 – x – (25x/100)

-8 = 25 – x – x/4

5x/4 = 33

x = 132/5 = 26.4%

questions.question: What x is added to each of 10, 16, 22 and 32, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between the numbers (x + 1) and (3x + 1)?
questions.solution:
If, x is added to each of 10, 16, 22 and 32, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion, then

According to the question

(10 + x) : (16 + x) :: (22 + x) : (32 + x)

(10 + x)/(16 + x) = (22 + x)/(32 + x)

We can solve this using cross multiplication or Using Componendo or Dividendo but hare we can solve this using equal difference between 16 – 10 = 6 and 32 – 22 = 10. For makes calculation easy and saves time.

6 × 5 = 30 and 10 × 3 = 30

Now,

5 (10 + x) = 3 (22 + x)

50 + 5x = 66 + 3x

2x = 16

x = 8

Now,

Let the mean proportional between the numbers (x + 1) and (3x + 1) be A, then

(x + 1) : A :: A : (3x + 1)

(8 + 1)/A = A/(3 × 8 + 1)

A² = 9 × (24 + 1)

A = √(9 × 25)

A = 3 × 5 = 15

questions.question: Diameter AB of a circle with centre O is produced to a point P such that PO = 16.8 cm. PQR is a secant that intersects the circle at Q and R such that PQ = 12 cm and PR = 19.2 cm. The length of AB (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3e63941ef96f892fed5909b173c7fac32c9bbac3444eb2c53ffb51bcc577976.png] 

Given, PO = 16.8, PQ = 12 and PR = 19.2

From the following figure

Let the radius of the circle AO = OB = x, then

PA = (16.8 + x) and PB = (16.8 – x)

As we know,

PB × PA = PQ × PR

(16.8 – x) (16.8 + x) = 12 × 19.2

16.8² – x² = 12 × 19.2

x² = 16.8² – 12 × 19.2 = 12² (1.4² – 1.6) = 144 × (1.96 – 1.60)

x = √(144 × 0.36)

x = 7.2

Hence, 2x = 14.4

∴AB = 14.4

**For easy calculation**

Given,

PO = 16.8, PQ = 12 and PR = 19.2

Divided by 12, then

PO = 1.4, PQ = 1 and PR = 1.6

Let the radius of the circle AO = OB = x, then

PA = (1.4 + x) and PB = (1.4 – x)

As we know,

PB × PA = PQ × PR

(1.4 – x) (1.4 + x) = 1 × 1.6

1.96 – x² = 1.6

x² = 0.36

x = √0.36

x = 0.6

2x = 1.2

AB = 1.2

Multiply by 12 in 1.2 and get correct answer = 1.2 × 12 = 14.4

questions.question: A and B spend 60% and 75% of their incomes, respectively. If the savings of A are 20% more than that of B, then by what percentage is the income of A less than the income of B?
questions.solution:
Using option 4

Assuming Income of A be **25%** less than B

So, Income of A = 75, Income of B = 100

Savings of A after expenditure of 60% = 75 - 60% of 75 = Rs.30

Savings of B after expenditure of 75% = 100 - 75% of 100 = Rs. 25

Savings of A is more than B by = (30 – 25)/25 × 100 = 20% (As the Question says the savings of A are 20% more than that of B Hence our assumption is correct)

**Detailed Method:**

Let the income of A and B be Rs. x and y respectively.

Savings of A = 40% of x

Savings of B = 25% of y

According to the question

(40% of x) = (25% of y) × (120/100)

x × 40% = y × 25% × 6/5

x : y = 3 : 4

Let income of A = 3 and income of B = 4

Income of A is less than that of B by = [(4 – 3)/4] × 100 = 25%

To complete a certain task, X is 40% more efficient than Y, and Z is 40% less efficient than Y. Working together, they can complete the task in 21 days. Y and Z together worked for 35 days. The remaining work will be completed by X alone in:
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of y be 5 unit

Efficiency of X = 5 × (7/5) = 7

Efficiency of Z = 5 × (3/5) = 3

Total work = (5 + 7 + 3) × 21 = 315

Work done by y and Z in 35 days = (5 + 3) × 35 = 280

Remaining work = 315 – 280 = 35

∴Remaining work will be completed by X alone in = 35/7 = 5 days

questions.question: If the radius of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 10%, and the height is increased by 20%, then the percentage increase/decrease in its volume is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c66f9ac75983f1b986eb22d2b883a305a41fd3b46107f72101919108617ea7f6.png] 

Ratio of volume before and after = 500 : 486

Again multiply by 2 in = 1000 : 972

Volume decreased by = 1000 – 972 = 28

As we know, 28 = 2.8%

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the radius of the cylinder be r cm and height of the cylinder be h cm,

As we know,

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

New radius of the cylinder = r × (90/100) = 0.9r cm

New height of the cylinder = h × (120/100) = 1.2h cm

New volume of the cylinder = π × (0.9r)² × 1.2h = 0.81r² × 1.2h × π = 0.972rhπ

Required percentage = [(πr²h - 0.972πrh)/πrh] × 100 = 2.8%

questions.question: When a positive integer is divided by d, the remainder is 15. When ten times of the same number is divided by d, the remainder is 6. The least possible value of d is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When a positive number is divided by d, the remainder is 15

When ten times of the same number is divided by d, the remainder is 6

**Calculation:**

As given, Remainder is 15 so we can say the value of d is greater than 15. Only 16 and 18 is greater than 15.

Let us try with the least of the two options

Since the minimum value for the positive number, for 15 to be remainder when divided by 16 = 31

Ten times of 31 = 310

310/16 → 6 (remainder) 

Since from there only we got the solution, we need not check for 18 as it is asked for the least value of d.

**So the value of d is 16.**

questions.question: If x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = 273 and x² – xy + y² = 13, then the value of xy is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x² – xy + y² = 13 ----(1)

x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = 273 

**Formula used:**

(x2 – xy + y2)(x2 + xy + y2) = x4 + x2y2 + y4

**Calculation:**

(x² – xy + y²)(x² + xy + y²) = x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴

⇒ 13 × (x² + xy + y²) = 273

⇒ (x² + xy + y²) = 273/13 = 21 ----(2)

eq(2) - eq(1),

2xy = 8

⇒ xy = 4

**∴ xy = 4**

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which sides AD and BC are produced to meet at P, and sides DC and AB meet at Q when produced. If ∠A = 60° and ∠ABC = 72°, then ∠DPC –∠BQC = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09cea4fc5b62739a757ea2921062fa8a12644386e0d21178cab9694092bf282d.png] 

∠A = 60° and ∠ABC = 72°

In ΔAPB

∠PAB + ∠ABP + ∠APB = 180°

∠APB = 180° – 60° – 72° = 48°

∠APB = ∠DPC = 48°

As we know, In cyclic quadrilateral, sum of opposite angles are 180°.

∠ABC + ∠ADC = 180°

∠ADC = 180° – 72° = 108°

In ΔADQ

∠DAQ + ∠ADQ + ∠AQD = 180°

∠AQD = 180° – 60° – 108° = 12°

Difference between ∠DPC and ∠BQC = 48° – 12° = 36°
